title: The Streets Decide
text: The crowd that put you in the palace took it back. You left through the kitchen.

title: Beloved Unto Death
text: They loved you so much they stopped needing the rest of the government. Then they stopped needing you.

title: Insufficient Funds
text: The treasury bounced its own cheque. The creditors sent a new leader with the bailout.

title: Owned
text: The people who paid for everything would now like a receipt. It has your office on it.

title: Nobody in Charge
text: The last policeman went home. So did everyone else. The palace is a squat now.

title: Security Concern
text: The security services concluded that you were the last remaining threat to security.

title: Out of Office
text: There was no ministry left to sign your removal, so nobody did. You simply stopped being in charge.

title: Pending Review
text: Your removal was approved by all forty-one committees. It took nine years. You were long gone.

title: Conceded
text: You lost. You said so on television, which is more than most manage. The moving van came Tuesday.

title: Change of Management
text: The generals thanked you for your service in a short broadcast. You were not invited to it.

title: Under Its Own Weight
text: The lights went out for the last time, and nobody in the building knew which switch it was.

title: Still Standing
text: The country neither fell nor flew. Historians argue about whether that counts.

title: Orbit
text: The first ship left on time. The people who built it remembered who let them.

title: The Long Way Down
text: Five centuries on, the capital is a ruin with a gift shop. The guide says the fall took everyone. The tourists still ask who started it.

title: The Oldest Argument
text: Five centuries on, the parliament still sits, the deficit is still open and the trains are still late. Nobody alive has seen it end, or wants to.

title: The Far Shore
text: Five centuries on, ships leave for other stars as routinely as trains once left for the coast. Nobody remembers who first let them go.

title: A Quiet Arrangement
text: You were not removed. You were kept, like a signature on a file, by people who had the file.

title: Removed by Vote
text: The chamber found against you by nine votes. It was the last institution still able to count.

title: An Internal Matter
text: The man you made powerful decided the arrangement had become inefficient. The state funeral was very well attended.

title: A Standing Invitation
text: A friendly country offered you a house by a lake. You took it while the offer was still phrased as an offer.

title: Leader for Life
text: They gave you the title, the portrait and the rest of your life in the same building. It was a long life.

title: Handed Over
text: You left on a Tuesday, on time, to someone competent. The country barely noticed, which was the achievement.

title: Insufficiently Committed
text: The list you started reached your own name. You signed it yourself, which they said showed real discipline.

title: Nobody Came
text: The people who knocked on doors for you stopped knocking. There was no announcement. There was just nobody there.

title: Funding Withdrawn
text: The people who paid for all of it stopped paying for all of it. The campaign office lights went out first.

title: They Won
text: The count came in on time, was not disputed, and was not close. {rival} gave a gracious speech about continuity.

title: The Last Signature
text: The enemy would sign with anyone but you, so you signed and resigned the same afternoon. The pen is in a museum now. So is the war.

title: Contempt of Court
text: The court held you in contempt. The army was asked to choose between you and the court, and chose the court, politely.

title: In Receivership
text: The lenders run the budget now. They kept your office open for the photographs, and then the photographs stopped.

title: Taking Responsibility
text: You read the name in the chamber and resigned before anyone could call a vote. It is the only resignation speech the country still quotes.
